description: Use this when the user has no data center site yet and wants candidate search areas (site selection by substation voltage, gas and fiber distance); execute_plan covers a multi-part siting question. THE INVERSE QUERY: every other DC Hub siting tool needs a coordinate you already have — analyze_site scores one, get_composite_site_score grades one, rank_sites orders candidates YOU already enriched, find_alternatives needs a seed facility. This one answers "where should I even be looking?". Returns candidate SEARCH AREAS anchored on real HIFLD substations at or above min_voltage_kv, spatially de-duplicated by cluster_km so a dense metro yields distinct areas instead of 40 near-identical rows, each carrying measured distance to the nearest gas pipeline and fiber route plus state-grain moratorium context, and a next_calls handoff. Answers "where should I even be looking for 200 MW in Ohio" and "which areas near Dallas sit on 230kV with gas within 5 miles". Try: find_sites state=OH min_voltage_kv=230 max_gas_km=8 — or find_sites lat=39.04 lon=-77.48 radius_km=60 min_voltage_kv=500.

cluster_km.description: Collapse anchors within this many km into one candidate area (default 8, max 100). Raise it for broader coverage, lower it for denser results

exclude_moratorium.description: true = drop candidates in a state with a published data-center moratorium. STATE grain, not jurisdiction grain

lat.description: Latitude of a search centre, e.g. 39.04 — use with lon (+ radius_km) instead of state

latitude.description: Alias for lat — either name works

limit.description: Max results to return (1-500; default varies by tool)

lng.description: Alias for lon — either name works

lon.description: Longitude of a search centre, e.g. -77.48

longitude.description: Alias for lon — either name works

max_fiber_km.description: Drop candidates farther than this from the nearest fiber route (CHORD approximation — see fiber_distance_basis). Applied ONLY if the fiber layer answers

max_gas_km.description: Drop candidates farther than this from the nearest gas pipeline. Applied ONLY if the gas layer answers — check constraint_coverage

min_voltage_kv.description: Only anchor on substations at or above this voltage in kV (default 115). 230+ for hyperscale, 500 for the largest campuses

radius_km.description: Search radius in km around lat/lon (default 80, clamped 5-400); ignored in state mode

state.description: 2-letter US state to search, e.g. OH — required unless you pass lat + lon

name: find_sites
title: Find Sites
